entities.name: Entity of the Bog
entities.description: A Worldsoul hidden in the Bog on Innistrad that bound villagers' souls to it, later split between twins and made whole in Tacenda.

entities.name: The Bog
entities.description: Location in the Approaches where the Entity hid.

entities.name: The Approaches
entities.description: Region of Innistrad containing the Bog and Verlasen.

entities.name: Merlinde
entities.description: Prioress sent by the Church of Avacyn who built the priory of the Nameless Angel to counter the Bog.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Church that sent Merlinde to the Approaches.

entities.name: Nameless Angel
entities.description: Angel the priory was built for, murdered by the priory's people and later struck by Emrakul's madness.

entities.name: Seelenstone
entities.description: Stone that siphoned souls away from the Bog Entity.

entities.name: Willia Verlasen
entities.description: Twin, acolyte at the Priory who gathers the Bog's power and is killed by her sister.

entities.name: Tacenda Verlasen
entities.description: Twin who kills Willia, becomes whole with the Entity, and vanishes with it.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Creatures made from Willia's parents and others, defeated by Tacenda.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose madness struck the Nameless Angel.

entities.name: Verlasen
entities.description: Village whose people's souls Willia pulled out.

events.summary: Merlinde looks into the Bog, finds the Entity, builds the priory of the Nameless Angel and converts souls from the Bog.
events.quote: she built the priory of the Nameless Angel

events.summary: With its souls siphoned by the Seelenstone, the Entity leaves the Bog and ends up split between the unborn twins Willia and Tacenda.
events.quote: ended up split between the twin sisters

events.summary: The Entity speaks to Willia, who kills her parents by accident, turning them into Whisperers.
Willia loses faith on learning the priory murdered the Nameless Angel, gathers the Bog's power and breaks the Seelenstone.
events.quote: she broke it to release its souls for the benefit of the Bog Entity

events.summary: Tacenda finds the dead Nameless Angel, learns a new song, defeats the Whisperers and, with Davriel Cane, kills Willia; the Entity is whole in Tacenda.
events.quote: With help of Davriel Cane , she also overcame and killed Willia.

events.summary: Tacenda merges with the Entity, releases souls and vanishes with it.
events.quote: Tacenda vanished, taking the Bog Entity with her.

relations.quote: With help of Davriel Cane , she also overcame and killed Willia.
a woman pregnant with two daughters - Willia and Tacenda Verlasen

relations.note: Found it terrible and opposed it.
relations.quote: she found the Bog Entity to be terrible, vast, and ancient
